subject: I cannot open a connection when using reactive()

messages.author: 3cbc4d04414bd946
messages.subject: I cannot open a connection when using reactive()
parts:
This works in shiny MBSData <- MBS(MBS.id = "bondlabMBS")

This does not work in shiny
   MBSData <- reactive({MBS(MBS.id = input$bond.id)
                               do some things
        })

I get the following error

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3409
Warning in gzfile(description = paste(system.file(package = "BondLab"),  :
cannot open compressed file '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.2/Resources/library/BondLab/BondData/bondlabMBS4.rds', probable reason 'No such file or directory'
Error in gzfile(description = paste(system.file(package = "BondLab"),  : 
cannot open the connection


The connection function code is as follows:
  #' A connection function to the BondData calling MBS cusps
  #' 
  #' Opens a connection to the BondData folder to call MBS cusip data 
  #' @param MBS.id A character string the MBS.id or cusip number current MBS.id is supported
  #' @export
  MBS <- function(MBS.id = "character"){
                  MBS.Conn <- gzfile(description = paste(system.file(package = "BondLab"),
                              "/BondData/", MBS.id, ".rds", sep = ""), open = "rb")          
                  MBS <- readRDS(MBS.Conn)
                  on.exit(close.connection(MBS.Conn))
                  return(MBS)
                  }
    setGeneric("MBS", function(MBS.id = "character")
      {standardGeneric("MBS")}) 

I know the connection works so it has to be something that I am not doing when I try to make it reactive.  I am stumped so any help is appreciated.


==============================================================
